independent_technical_reasoning: Subblock 1 is not a stable physical identity until the current block-7 enumeration is bound to OAM and AID. A DataLossErr is materially different from corrected BER evidence because the fabric or host can disappear before in-band capture completes. Thus the decisive chain is enumeration, one timestamped stimulus, durable CPER ext0 identity, observed fatal transition, and restored link topology—not merely a command success string or one larger log ID.
